New cost-basis/market-value business logic in PortfolioSummaryService ships with no unit tests.

findings.rule: CLAUDE.md §10 Market hours / Timezone (America/New_York — never UTC for market hours)
findings.reason: Session window 09:30–16:00 is evaluated in UTC (05:30–12:00 ET / 04:30–11:00 EST), so LIMIT orders fill pre-market and are frozen for most of the real session.

Swallowing all exceptions in the listener bypasses the DefaultErrorHandler, so failed executions are never retried or sent to order.execution.requested.DLT and the offset is committed — the order is silently lost in SENT_TO_EXECUTION.
SELL proceeds are truncated with the deprecated ROUND_DOWN int constant instead of HALF_UP, inconsistent with the BUY path and the mandated money rounding.

findings.rule: client-service CLAUDE.md §10 (Never allow negative cash balance after reservation) / §11 buyingPower
findings.reason: Commission is debited on BUY fills but never included in the reserved-cash / buying-power check, so a client trading up to full buying power is driven below zero cash.
Only the BUY path is tested; the new SELL commission/net-proceeds logic has no unit test.

findings.rule: CLAUDE.md §6 Level 2 check #12 (Self trade check — no open opposite order at crossing price)
findings.reason: Crossing comparison is inverted versus the original logic (BUY crosses when resting sell limit <= buy limit), so genuine self-crosses pass validation and non-crossing orders are wrongly rejected.
New extracted Level 2 business logic (including SHORT_SELL side expansion) has no unit tests, which would have caught the inverted comparison.

findings.rule: CLAUDE.md §12 REST API Standards / correctness (bounded list endpoints, MAX_PAGE_SIZE)
findings.reason: Unpaged query bypasses the MAX_PAGE_SIZE cap and, with createdAfter optional, returns every order ever stored rather than a full-day view — unbounded memory/response size.
FILLED/PARTIALLY_FILLED orders are reported with filledQuantity 0 and null avgFillPrice, giving the desk an incorrect blotter.
